name: shipgate-hud
description: A Claude Code mod that draws a shipgate flow's position: stream, phase, tasks and verify evidence in a band above the prompt, and a phase-aware pane with the gate decisions (veto in one press), the Build Plan with journal evidence, the committed design, a Review board fed by the review workflow's return, and the worklog's diagrams drawn on desktop and as box-drawing pictures in the terminal. Holds git push, gh pr create and glab mr create until the stream is reviewed or the user lets it through once. Reads shipgate's journal through its CLI; draws nothing in a project without a shipgate journal.

journalScript.title: journal.py path
journalScript.description: Absolute path to shipgate's scripts/journal.py when the HUD cannot find it beside itself (marketplace checkout or plugin cache).
